blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania has to offer is a dream. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a Kilimanjaro climb or time on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: you will find it all in Tanzania. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary around all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: Looking for inspiration? Our most popular itineraries are a good place to start. Most of our clients like to round off their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Whether you pick one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather shape the journey yourself, we are happy to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you when you land at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel, where you can rest after your flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb begins, you meet your guide for a briefing, with advice on what to wear, what to pack and other useful tips to make the climb as comfortable as possible.

blocks.orig: Our guide picks you up from the hotel in the morning and takes you to Machame Gate, where your unforgettable Kili climb begins! As you ascend through the stunning landscapes, lush rainforests gradually transition into heather moorlands. After a five to six-hour hike, you reach the Machame Camp on the edge of the forest area with a heath zone. This is your first day at this altitude, so remember to drink plenty of water!
blocks.html: In the morning our guide collects you from the hotel and drives you to Machame Gate, the starting point of your unforgettable Kili climb! As you make your way up through the beautiful scenery, the lush rainforest slowly gives way to heather moorland. After a hike of five to six hours you arrive at Machame Camp, on the edge of the forest where the heath zone begins. It is your first day at this altitude, so be sure to drink plenty of water!

blocks.orig: This second day on the mountain starts with another nice climb that is a little steeper. You first pass to a small circular cliff known as the picnic rock where you are rewarded with stunning views of Kibo (a peak of Kilimanjaro) and Shira (one of the other volcanic peaks). From the picnic rock, you hike on to Shira Camp via a beautiful route to have lunch and rest. If you wish, you can take an acclimatisation walk towards the Lava Tower (to an altitude of 4,630 meters and a distance of 2 km).
blocks.html: Your second day on the mountain begins with another pleasant, slightly steeper climb. First you reach a small circular cliff called the picnic rock, where stunning views of Kibo (one of Kilimanjaro's peaks) and Shira (another of the volcanic peaks) are your reward. From there, a beautiful route takes you on to Shira Camp for lunch and a rest. If you like, you can do an acclimatisation walk towards the Lava Tower (up to an altitude of 4,630 meters, over a distance of 2 km).

blocks.orig: From Shira Camp you trek to the beautiful Lava Tower for lunch. This part of the climb has many ascents and descents and offers beautiful views along the way. It is important to find your right pace, as this is a longer hike and you might feel a bit uncomfortable due to the increased altitude. After lunch, you descend to Barranco Camp at the foot of the imposing Barranco Wall, which is impressive in both its sheer size and steepness.
blocks.html: From Shira Camp you hike to the beautiful Lava Tower, where you have lunch. This stretch has many ups and downs and lovely views along the way. Finding the right pace matters, because this is a longer hike and the higher altitude may make you feel a little uncomfortable. After lunch you descend to Barranco Camp, at the foot of the imposing Barranco Wall, which impresses with both its sheer size and its steepness.

blocks.orig: After breakfast you depart from Barranco Camp to the Barranco Wall. For many people this is their favorite part of the climb. Once at the top of the Barranco Wall, you have a spectacular view to the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru.
blocks.html: Once you have had breakfast, you set off from Barranco Camp towards the Barranco Wall. Plenty of climbers say this is the part they enjoy most. At the top of the wall, a spectacular view of Mount Meru and the Kibo Volcano opens up.

blocks.orig: A more difficult hike starts later on to reach Karanga Camp. This route has many ascents and descents, so keep the right pace. You have lunch at the camp and after a rest you can take an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp.
blocks.html: Later on, a tougher hike begins to reach Karanga Camp. The route goes up and down a lot, so keep to the right pace. Lunch is at the camp, and after resting you can do an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp.

blocks.orig: Today you hike to Barafu Camp, the starting point for your ascent to Uhuru Peak - the top of Kilimanjaro! You arrive at the camp around lunch. Have a rest and after you regain your strength, take an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and experience the thrill of high-altitude camping as you prepare for the final push to the summit around midnight.
blocks.html: Today's hike takes you to Barafu Camp, from where you will set off for Uhuru Peak - the top of Kilimanjaro! You reach the camp around lunchtime. Take a rest and, once you have your strength back, do an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Take in the breathtaking views of the peaks around you and enjoy the thrill of camping at high altitude while you get ready for the final push to the summit around midnight.

blocks.orig: The big day has arrived! Around midnight, you start from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak. The climb leads over good trails and the most challenging part is the high altitude. Once you reach the summit, you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After a short time at the top, where you celebrate your ultimate triumph, you descend slowly to the scenic Millennium Camp.
blocks.html: The big day is here! Around midnight you set off from Barafu Camp towards Uhuru Peak. The trails are good, and the high altitude is the toughest part. At the summit you can watch a beautiful sunrise, which is very impressive at this height! You spend a short while at the top celebrating your ultimate triumph, and then you slowly descend to the scenic Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: The Millennium Camp is located in a tropical rainforest. When you wake up today, you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit the day before. After breakfast, you take an easy walk to Mweka Gate, the exit of Kilimanjaro National Park.
blocks.html: Millennium Camp lies in a tropical rainforest. Waking up today, you feel relief thanks to the lower altitude, and satisfaction at having reached the summit the day before. After breakfast an easy walk brings you to Mweka Gate, where you leave Kilimanjaro National Park.

blocks.orig: Your driver then brings you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest. Unforgettable memories, breathtaking views, and a true sense of accomplishment await and will stay forever with you!
blocks.html: Afterwards the driver brings you back to your hotel for a well-earned rest. You take home unforgettable memories, breathtaking views and a real feeling of achievement, all of which will be with you for good!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Sadly, the holiday is over and it is time to head home. Enjoy your final hours in the country until our driver picks you up for the transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport and your flight back. Still not ready to leave? A few days on safari or on the beach can easily be added to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
